fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (RSS or sitemap) carry title/link-style fields. Upstream JSON-LD is passed through close to verbatim, so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may also appear.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest'/'latest:<section>') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-jsonld, S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (e.g. not_found, unexpected_shape).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keyword list, split from a comma-separated string.

imageUrl.title: Image URL
imageUrl.description: Lead image URL from the RSS <enclosure> tag.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
